image_description: A black, heavy-duty ring binder standing upright against a white background. The binder features a wide orange spine with 'Heavy Duty' text and branding. The front cover has a large clear plastic pocket containing an insert that displays a graphic of the internal ring mechanism and product details. Text is visible on the spine and the front insert.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The graphic of the metal ring mechanism on the paper insert lacks realistic metallic reflection and looks slightly painted/soft compared to the sharp plastic of the binder itself.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific sub-type (view binder) and brand consistency.
To rigorously check the legibility of 'Wilson Jones', 'Heavy Duty', and the garbled red badge text.
To ensure the plastic pocket overlay blends correctly with the cover and doesn't show fusion artifacts at the edges.
To detect any subtle lighting inconsistencies or global blur issues.

focus_areas: Text legibility on spine and insert
Boundary between clear pocket and black cover
Realism of the printed graphic on the insert
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the red badge; AI often fails to render small, dense text correctly. Also, verify if the 'metallic' sheen on the printed insert looks like real metal or just grey paint, which would indicate a texture generation failure.
